correctness.rationale: For each convex polygonal face the ordered interior pair integral is pi*A*r^2 - (2/3)*L*r^3 + O(r^4). Adjacent face pairs yield twice the 3D ball-wedge integral 2*(pi-theta)*r^3/(3*sin(theta)) per edge length; vertex-only pairs are O(r^4). This proves the formula. For boxes exact face autocorrelation and quarter-ball integrals yield the quartic polynomial for r<min(a,b,c); centering computes M2. Solving elementary symmetric polynomials and the cubic gives inverse uniqueness. Standalone randomized and quadrature checks pass; finite checks alone are not the proof.

value.rationale: The first departure from planar pi*r^2/S surface-point behavior is a positive dihedral-angle-weighted edge invariant, a structural observable for any convex polyhedron. Exact all-box short-distance laws and one global second moment uniquely determine arbitrary three-dimensional rectangular-box side lengths. It provides a precise, natural inverse geometric classification from only three scalar distance statistics, rather than a table recomputation or arbitrary narrow numerical instance.
